name: Bleed Glory
body:
Source Mythic Adventures pg. 113
School necromancy [curse]; Level arcanist 3, cleric 3, medium 1, mesmerist 3, oracle 3, psychic 3, sorcerer 3, warpriest 3, witch 3, wizard 3
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Effect
Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one mythic creature
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes
Description
The mythic power cost for all path abilities, feats, spells, and other effects used by the target increases by 1.
